materials.title: Why did market fall today? Sensex drops 460 points, Nifty closes below 22,700. Key factors behind Rs 3 lakh crore rout
materials.description:
Market Drop: Sensex fell 460 points to 73,249, Nifty lost 124 points to 22,688, wiping out over Rs 3 lakh crore from total market capitalization.
Rising Oil Prices: Brent crude surged to around $110.7.......

comments.text: not able to see any oter docs

The Indian stock market extended sharp losses on Thursday, with Sensex and Nifty dropping up to 0.6% as oil prices jumped and indices saw sharp volatility during the CAS session on Sensex’s expiry day.

Sensex dropped over 460 points to close at 73,249, and Nifty 50 lost 124 points to end the session at 22,688. The drop wiped out more than Rs 3 lakh crore from the total market capitalisation of all companies listed on BSE, dragging it down to Rs 458 lakh crore.

Reliance Industries (RIL), Eternal, HDFC Bank, Power Grid, Trent, Asian Paints, Infosys, ITC and BEL shares fell 1-3% to lead losses on Sensex, while Bajaj Finance, UltraTech Cement, ICICI Bank and Sun Pharma gained nearly 1-2%.

Broader markets plunged deeper into the red, with Nifty Smallcap 100 and Nifty Midcap 100 indices falling around 1% each. This came as India VIX, which measures volatility in the market, inched up to 15.82
